title: Settings
calendarHint: First and last day of the month and week follow this calendar — not the language.
currencyHint: Rial is shown ×10 (10 rial = 1 toman). Dollar is a label only.
backupHint: Keeps money, calendar, notes, and these settings on this device. App updates keep your data. Uninstalling does not.
privacyBody: Everything stays on this phone. No account, no cloud, no tracking.
remindersHint: Default for money items. You can override per item when editing.
